title: Purchase-Volume Relief on Northgate+ Business Reversals
content:
**Rule.** Under the Business return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, a business with high purchasing volume receives relief on the reversal. The volume is the total of the net amounts — the amounts charged after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount — of the lines on the member's Northgate orders on Northgate Store and Online Orders dated within the twelve whole calendar months before today (dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by today).

| Total net amount of those lines (USD) | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 0.1 |
| 2000 to less than 5000 | 0.05 |
| less than 2000 | nothing |

**Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical totals).** 5000.00 adds 0.1 and 4999.99 adds 0.05; 2000.00 adds 0.05 and 1999.99 adds nothing.
